tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the root README and the two application readmes to understand the trading platform split.

tour.title: Frontend Entry Points
tour.description: Review the Next.js app entry points and providers that mount the client experience.

tour.title: Frontend Trading Surface
tour.description: Inspect terminal, dashboard, charting, portfolio, orders, bots, and watchlist UI components.

tour.title: Frontend Data Boundary
tour.description: Follow API clients, auth, market context, and websocket plumbing into backend-facing calls.

tour.title: Backend Core Server
tour.description: Read the primary Go entry point, router, middleware, auth handler, and auth service.

tour.title: Backend Service Mesh
tour.description: Explore the microservice entry points for gateway, identity, orders, portfolio, market data, queues, and execution.

tour.title: Deployment Shape
tour.description: Finish with Docker, compose, and hosting configuration to see how the services are packaged.
